From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Morales <dana.morales@evergreenhealth.com>; Alex Palmer <alex.palmer@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evergreen Health — Success Charter, Dependencies & Accepted MAP

Hi Dana and Alex,

Great to meet you on yesterday's demo — thanks for the thoughtful questions. Per our conversation, I wanted to put a concise success charter + proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) timeline in one place so we can lock milestones and owners before the contract SOW is finalized. I attached a working MAP (Evergreen_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short draft SOW so your procurement team can see alignment.

Top-level asks from our side:
- Confirm go-live acceptance criteria (page 2 of the MAP).
- Identify any non-negotiable blackout windows or internal freezes in July–September.
- Confirm the primary technical contact for data ingestion (we named Alex, please confirm).

Proposed 12-week cadence (high level):
1) Week 0–2: Provisioning & infra checklist, service account keys, and security handshake. (Owner: Redwood infra — Ben)
2) Week 3–5: Data mapping + test ingestion, initial quality checks. (Owner: Evergreen data ops — Alex)
3) Week 6–9: Feature integration, acceptance test runs, and performance tuning. (Owner: Redwood CS — Marissa)
4) Week 10–12: UAT, cutover weekend window, go-live + 30-day hypercare. (Owners: joint)

If this looks reasonable we can convert the sheet into a living shared Drive and mark the canary/cutover windows. Please reply with any conflicting dates and a preferred time for a short alignment call this week (15–30m).

Thanks — looking forward to the partnership.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Evergreen_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-Redwood-Evergreen-draft.pdf (PDF)

Thanks, Stephanie — this is exactly what I was hoping for. Quick answers:
- Acceptance criteria look right; I'll confirm a final list with compliance but page 2 covers the big ones.
- We have a planned maintenance freeze Aug 6–9 (quarterly); can the go-live avoid that window?
- Confirmed: Alex is our data lead and will own mapping and test ingestion.

I can meet Thursday 10:30–11:00 PT for a short sync. Also, one ask: can you add an explicit dependency line for "SOC 2 evidence review" under the provisioning tasks? Our procurement requires that before we sign the SOW.

Dana Morales
